svg.title: Kefa Foundation logger UML class diagram
svg.desc: LogRegistry associates with Logger; Logger associates with ILogSink and creates LogRecord. LogSink realizes ILogSink. ConsoleSink and FileSink inherit LogSink and each compose one LogPatternFormatter. LogPatternFormatter uses LogRecord, whose Level is ELogLevel.

g.text: + public − private # protected italic = abstract {leaf} = final
Solid line: association · Triangle: inheritance / realization (dashed) · Diamond: composition · Dashed arrow: dependency
